items.title: Rebecca Kilgore interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 13, 1997
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Best to be a good singer I guess. I mean Nancy Wilson doesn’t think of herself as a jazz singer either. [INTERVIEWEE] Really? Wow.

ctx.x: Yeah that’s interesting because I really don’t in some ways consider myself a jazz singer. Of course that’s a very controversial tag. You know, who knows what that means? I don’t improvises all that much and I stick pretty close to the melody, but I’m not like a show singer. I don’t belt it out. So I’m somewhere in another world.
Best to be a good singer I guess. I mean Nancy Wilson doesn’t think of herself as a jazz singer either.
